FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine:3.23

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG BEETS_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="aptalca"

RUN \
  echo "**** install build packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache --virtual=build-dependencies \
    build-base \
    cairo-dev \
    cargo \
    cmake \
    ffmpeg-dev \
    fftw-dev \
    git \
    gobject-introspection-dev \
    jpeg-dev \
    libedit-dev \
    libpng-dev \
    mpg123-dev \
    openjpeg-dev \
    python3-dev && \
  echo "**** install runtime packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    chromaprint \
    expat \
    ffmpeg \
    fftw \
    flac \
    gdbm \
    gobject-introspection \
    gst-plugins-good \
    gstreamer \
    imagemagick \
    jpeg \
    lame \
    libffi \
    libpng \
    mpg123 \
    mp3gain \
    nano \
    openjpeg \
    python3 \
    sqlite-libs && \
  echo "**** install beets ****" && \
  if [ -z ${BEETS_VERSION+x} ] ; then \
    BEETS_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/beetbox/beets/commits/master" \
    | jq -r .sha); \
  fi && \
  git clone https://github.com/beetbox/beets.git /tmp/beets && \
  cd /tmp/beets && \
  git checkout -f "${BEETS_VERSION}" && \
  echo "**** compile mp3val ****" && \
  mkdir -p \
    /tmp/mp3val-src && \
  curl -o \
  /tmp/mp3val-src/mp3val.tar.gz -sL \
    https://downloads.sourceforge.net/mp3val/mp3val-0.1.8-src.tar.gz && \
  cd /tmp/mp3val-src && \
  tar xzf /tmp/mp3val-src/mp3val.tar.gz --strip 1 && \
  make -f Makefile.linux && \
  cp -p mp3val /usr/bin && \
  echo "**** install pip packages ****" && \
  python3 -m venv /lsiopy && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir \
    pip \
    setuptools && \
  echo "**** install beets ****" && \
  cd /tmp/beets && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.23/ . && \
  echo "**** install pip packages ****" && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.23/ \
    beautifulsoup4 \
    beets-extrafiles \
    beetcamp \
    python3-discogs-client \
    flask \
    flask-cors \
    PyGObject \
    pyacoustid \
    pylast \
    requests \
    requests_oauthlib \
    typing-extensions \
    unidecode && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apk del --purge \
    build-dependencies && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    $HOME/.cache \
    $HOME/.cargo

# environment settings
ENV BEETSDIR="/config" \
EDITOR="nano" \
HOME="/config"

# copy local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 8337
VOLUME /config

units.name: init-beets-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# copy config
cp -n /defaults/beets.sh /config/beets.sh
cp -n /defaults/config.yaml /config/config.yaml

chmod +x /config/beets.sh

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    # permissions
    lsiown -R abc:abc \
        /config
fi

units.name: svc-beets
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 8337" \
            s6-setuidgid abc beet web
else
    exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 8337" \
            beet web
fi

notes.upstream:
Log failed metadata searches without a traceback at error level (#7119)

## Description

Fixes #6960.

When MusicBrainz is down or unreachable, `beet import` prints a 50-line
urllib3/requests traceback for every search. `_search_api` in
`beets/metadata_plugins.py` catches the error but logs it at error level
with `exc_info=True`.

Search failures caused by `requests` (`ConnectionError`, `Timeout`,
retries exhausted, HTTP errors) now log the one-line message at error
level, for example `Error searching MusicBrainz:
HTTPSConnectionPool(host='musicbrainz.org', port=443): Max retries
exceeded ...`, and keep the traceback at debug level. That is how
`maybe_handle_plugin_error` in the same module already logs plugin
failures. `raise_on_error` still re-raises, and errors that are not from
`requests` keep the full traceback, since those are more likely bugs.

The thread suggested catching connection errors in `RequestHandler`
instead. I kept the change in `_search_api` because every search-based
metadata source goes through it, including plugins that do not use
`RequestHandler`, and the plugins' other error handling stays as it is.
Happy to move it if you prefer that layer.

The new test in `test/test_metadata_plugins.py` makes
`get_search_response` raise `ConnectionError` and checks that the error
record has the message and no traceback. It fails without the change.

Tests: `pytest test/test_metadata_plugins.py
test/plugins/test_musicbrainz.py`, 73 passed (72 before the new test).

This change was prepared with an AI coding assistant (Claude Code,
claude-sonnet-5-5) and reviewed before submission.

## To Do

- [x] ~Documentation.~
- [x] Changelog.
- [x] Tests.
